candidates.source_name: FINAS – Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia (membership directory)
candidates.why_relevant: FINAS site states 70+ member companies spanning payments, blockchain, banking software, consulting and insurtech (named examples seen: VISA, 365.bank, Akcenta, Crypto Voucher, ANASOFT, DigFin, FinReg Partners). A member roster exposes an entire cohort of SK payments actors and their partners in one place, years before some appear in statutory registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of /en/membership/ and /sk/ equivalent plus the per-member staff pages (e.g. /en/staff/<slug>/); diff member sets quarterly to detect new entrants and departures.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en + sk association-name search, then direct fetch of association site
queries_used: Slovak Fintech Association members list payments
FINAS finas.sk členovia zoznam members fintech insurtech Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (SFA) – členstvo / členovia a predstavenstvo
candidates.why_relevant: The older (founded Aug 2018) Slovak FinTech Association; site sections observed include Členstvo (kategórie, členovia, predstavenstvo), memoranda, events, blog. Memoranda sections are especially valuable — they document bank/regulator/association partnerships. Board composition (Ivan Kubaš, Peter Papan, Jozef Semančín, Kamil Krauspe) is itself an actor map of SK payments influencers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members/board/memoranda subpages (membership sign-up path observed at /stante-sa-clenom/); snowball each member name into the SK Business Register (ORSR) and NBS registers.
queries_used: slovenská fintech asociácia zoznam členov

candidates.source_name: NBS Innovation Hub (Inovačný hub NBS pre oblasť fintech)
candidates.why_relevant: Launched Apr 2019 with the Ministry of Finance; the regulator's single front door for fintech entrants (crowdfunding, virtual assets, mobile payment apps). Firms that consult the hub are typically pre-licence competitors — the hub's existence and its intake themes flag where new SK payments activity is forming.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the EN and SK hub pages plus NBS aktuality RSS/news for hub announcements; treat contact-form page changes as low-signal, the activity reports as high-signal.
queries_used: NBS inovačný hub fintech Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS Innovation Hub – Activity Report series (Správa o činnosti inovačného hubu)
candidates.why_relevant: Periodic regulator report on what kinds of firms and use-cases approached the hub. Best available structured read on the pipeline of not-yet-licensed SK fintech/paytech entrants and on which business models NBS is being asked about.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the publications index for new report editions; extract PDF text; tag by business model and by any named firms.
queries_used: NBS inovačný hub fintech Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS regulačný sandbox (regulatory sandbox / pieskovisko inovácií)
candidates.why_relevant: Launched early 2022 on top of the innovation hub; sandbox participants are named, licensable-in-progress fintechs — the earliest formal public signal that a new payments competitor intends to operate in SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch NBS aktuality filtered on 'sandbox'/'pieskovisko'/'inovácie'; cross-reference any named participant against subjekty.nbs.sk.
queries_used: NBS inovačný hub fintech Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS register of supervised entities (Subjekty finančného trhu)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative register of SK-supervised financial-market entities; the confirmation layer for every startup/association-member name discovered elsewhere, and where EU-passported entrants operating via branch appear. Complements the payment-institutions/AISP listing.
candidates.access_status: public web application; entity pages addressable by id (e.g. /sk/entity/504/)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate entity pages / use any export or search endpoint; snapshot monthly and diff to detect newly registered payment institutions, e-money institutions and AISPs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language register search while checking EU-passported entrants
queries_used: Revolut Bank pobočka Slovensko NBS zoznam zahraničné platobné inštitúcie pasportizácia register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Payment institutions and AISP listing
candidates.why_relevant: The specific supervisory listing for PSD2 actors (payment institutions, account information service providers) in SK — the statutory counterpart to the association/startup-database pointers in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch EN and SK versions on a monthly cadence; parse tables/PDF attachments; diff licence holders.
queries_used: Revolut Bank pobočka Slovensko NBS zoznam zahraničné platobné inštitúcie pasportizácia register

candidates.source_name: Revolut Slovensko – SK market site and Revolut Bank governance pages
candidates.why_relevant: Flagship EU-passported entrant in SK. The sk-SK product pages and the Revolut Bank UAB leadership/governance page document the SK product surface (accounts, transfers) and the licence path (ECB licence, supervised by Bank of Lithuania) — i.e. exactly how a passported competitor reaches SK customers without a SK licence.
candidates.legal_status: corporate website, terms apply to scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot sk-SK product, pricing and legal/governance pages quarterly; diff for new SK-specific products (e.g. business/acquiring) and for licence-entity changes.

candidates.source_name: Tracxn – FinTech startups in Slovakia (222-company sector explorer)
candidates.why_relevant: Largest single enumerated SK fintech cohort found (222 companies, 36 funded, 10 Series A+, ~$37.2M raised, 5 acquisitions, 2 IPOs; names surfaced include Inforbus, Finax, Blockmate, Innovatrics, VESTBERRY, TrustPay, Datamolino, DigFin). Ideal seed list to snowball into ORSR/NBS.

candidates.source_name: SAPIE – Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy (member base, 180+ orgs)

negative_findings.description: Neither association's member list was read item-by-item in this pass. FINAS's homepage asserts 70+ members and names a handful (VISA, 365.bank, Akcenta, Prosman, SADAD, Crypto Voucher); slovakfintech.sk shows a Členstvo > členovia section but the roster itself was not enumerated here.
negative_findings.result_summary: Member-list URLs identified (finas.sk/en/membership/, slovakfintech.sk members subpage) but the full company rosters remain uncollected.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The member rosters are the single highest-value artefact in this cell; a run that stops at the association homepage misses the cohort it was sent to find.

negative_findings.description: Slovakia has at least two bodies both rendering in English as 'Slovak FinTech Association': Slovenská FinTech asociácia (slovakfintech.sk, IČO 51910497, founded Aug 2018, exec. director Peter Papan) and FINAS – Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia (finas.sk, president Davy Čajko). Third-party profiles (CB Insights, Apollo, RocketReach, LinkedIn) conflate them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Name collision confirmed across multiple sources; no evidence found of a merger or of one superseding the other.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream actor map risks double-counting or attributing a member/partnership to the wrong body. Both must be tracked separately and keyed by IČO, not by name.

negative_findings.description: No Dealroom.co Slovakia fintech slice URL surfaced in either sk or en searching; only Tracxn, Crunchbase hubs, ensun and StartupBlink appeared. Dealroom was mentioned only second-hand as a platform that covers SK.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dealroom SK slice not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Dealroom is a named target of this cell and is generally the strongest EU startup-funding dataset; its absence leaves a gap in funding-round coverage that Crunchbase/Tracxn only partly fill.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovak found the NBS innovation hub and regulatory sandbox pages, but no page listing which firms actually used the hub or entered the sandbox. Only the aggregate Activity Report series was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hub/sandbox exist and are documented; per-firm participation appears not to be published as a list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If NBS does not name participants, the earliest-entrant signal must come from the activity reports plus press coverage, not from a register — this changes the collection design.

negative_findings.description: Of the named EU-passported entrants, only Revolut produced concrete SK-specific evidence (sk-SK site, Revolut Bank UAB governance page, ECB licence supervised by Bank of Lithuania). No SK-specific source for Wise or Curve was located in this pass, in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Revolut covered; Wise and Curve uncovered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Passported entrants are competitors that never appear in SK statutory registers as licensees; if they are not tracked via their own SK-language market sites and via home-regulator passporting notifications, they are invisible to the whole programme.

negative_findings.description: Slovak search terms 'pasportizácia', 'zahraničné platobné inštitúcie', 'sloboda poskytovania služieb' did not surface a dedicated NBS list of inbound-passported EU payment institutions and e-money institutions serving SK cross-border.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the general subjekty.nbs.sk register and the domestic PI/AISP listing were found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The inbound-passporting list is the definitive enumeration of EU-licensed competitors legally serving SK; without it, competitor coverage is structurally incomplete. The EBA Credit Institutions/Payment Institutions registers are the likely fallback and should be scouted next.

coverage_gaps.description: The FINAS and Slovenská FinTech asociácia member rosters — the core deliverable of this cell — were located but not extracted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch finas.sk/en/membership/ (and its /sk/ twin) plus the slovakfintech.sk členovia page directly, extract every member name and URL, then resolve each to an IČO via finstat.sk / ORSR and tag those with payments relevance.

coverage_gaps.description: Inbound EU passporting into SK is not covered by any located register. Wise, Curve and other e-money/payment passportees have no confirmed SK-facing source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the EBA central Payment Institutions / EMI register and the home-regulator registers (Bank of Lithuania, FCA, NBB) filtered on Slovakia as host state; add each entrant's sk-SK market site as a direct source.

coverage_gaps.description: No Dealroom SK fintech slice and no StartupBlink/EU-Startups SK slice were captured, despite Dealroom being explicitly in scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search dealroom.co directly for a Slovakia country page and a fintech taxonomy filter; evaluate licence terms alongside Tracxn and Crunchbase and pick one paid dataset rather than three partial free ones.

coverage_gaps.description: Named SK funds surfaced only in passing (Crowdberry, Neulogy Ventures, Sandberg Investment Fund II, SeedStarter, Slovak Investment Holding; DEPO Ventures and Passion Capital as cross-border co-investors). None of their portfolio pages were visited.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a fund register for SK from innovationmapslovakia.sk/en/accelerator plus the SAPIE funding category, then crawl each fund's portfolio page and filter for payments/fintech holdings.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak Investment Holding domain (sih.sk) was inferred from the entity name rather than confirmed by a fetch or a search result.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm the canonical SIH domain and its press-release path on the next pass before treating it as a monitored source.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-side partnership disclosures (SLSP, 365.bank, Tatra banka, VÚB innovation/press pages) were touched only incidentally via the SLSP–Crowdberry landing page and the SLSP-authored Startup Report.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add each major SK bank's innovation/press/startup-programme page as a partnership source and pair it with the fintech-side claim for two-sided confirmation.

brief: The SK fintech/paytech entrant layer is unusually pointer-rich but fragmented: two rival associations (FINAS at finas.sk claiming 70+ members incl. VISA and 365.bank, and the older Slovenská FinTech asociácia at slovakfintech.sk, IČO 51910497) each publish a member roster, and SAPIE plus innovationmapslovakia.sk cover the surrounding accelerator/VC layer, so four directories between them expose most of the cohort. On the official side NBS supplies the innovation hub, the regulatory sandbox, the PI/AISP licence listing and the subjekty.nbs.sk register, with MF SR owning national fintech strategy; the hub and sandbox document the pipeline but do not appear to name participants, so early-entrant detection has to lean on the NBS activity reports plus Slovak trade press (Forbes.sk, FinReport.sk, Startitup.sk), which reliably named recent paytech rounds such as Veslo (EUR 2m with SIH) and Tapaya (EUR 1.2m, Passion Capital + DEPO Ventures). Commercial startup databases (Tracxn's 222-company SK fintech slice, Crunchbase SK hubs) give the broadest name lists but are paywalled and should be licensed rather than scraped, with FinStat/Transparex used to resolve every discovered name to a legal entity. The clearest structural gap is inbound EU passporting: only Revolut was evidenced with SK-specific sources, and no NBS list of cross-border-passported payment or e-money institutions was found, so EBA and home-regulator registers must be scouted next.
